zenogg.name: Zenogg
zenogg.origin: Zenogg was the ruler of the planet Planet Zenn, a planet that had not developed the concept of defense and so when their neighboring planet Quo began to develop starflight, they worried about being invaded. To prevent this, Zenogg contacted the Star Raiders, a group of escapees from the prison planet of Torgo who successfully engaged in space piracy. Zenogg asked them to attack and plunder the planet Quo, and the Star Raiders accepted also because it was well known that the inhabitants of Zenn were unable to lie and Zenogg had declared that the inhabitants of Quo were widgets. When they attacked the planet Quo however, the Star Raiders found themselves facing giants who easily captured all of the Star Raiders except their leader Brock. Escaping on the Star Raiders' spaceship, Brock contacted Zenogg asking him how it was possible that an inhabitant of Zenn could have deceived them, but Zenogg replied that he had not deceived them but that he had told the truth because for the inhabitants of Zenn all were gods midges since they were gigantic, bigger than the mountains.

zenzi.name: Zenzi
zenzi.origin: Zenzi was a Nigandan woman with the ability to enhance and bring to light people's deepest emotions. When she was about to be killed by the troops of the late Erik Killmonger in the edge of a mass grave, she managed to affect her would-be executors and make them kill each other. thumb|left|Zenzi empathically manipulating Wakandans Zenzi became the leader of the Nigandan Army, and allied herself with Tetu, the head of the Wakandan rebel movement known as the People, and used her abilities to incite riots. The Black Panther tracked her down two times. The first time, in the Nigandan Border Region, Zenzi made her escape while the Black Panther fell prey to her abilities. The second time, Black Panther and his Hatut Zeraze ambushed Zenzi, Tetu and several Nigandan soldiers in Southwest Wakanda. During the scuffle, Black Panther knocked out Zenzi, causing her to slip into a coma. Tetu retreated with her and managed to wake her up several days later. Zenzi helped Tetu establish friendly terms with a coexisting rebel force, the Dora Milaje, by using her powers to thwart an attack of Black Panther's Hatut Zeraze. Zenzi later used her abilities to empower the members of the Nigandian Army and have them march towards the Golden City in their final act to overthrow Black Panther. When the People approached the Golden City, Black Panther had old scholar Changamire speak out against Tetu and broadcast it through the Kimoyo Beads. His speech moved countless members of the People's army, which in turn caused the effect of freeing them from Zenzi's grasp. Tetu had her use those few who remained on their side to murder the would-be defectors. She then empowered the remaining soldiers, turning them into mindless brutes that managed to break into the Golden City. Zenzi remained behind the People's forces, so she was not captured when Tetu and his soldiers fell at the hands of Black Panther and his allies, and instead observed from a distance as her enterprise collapsed. Zenzi retreated towards the wilderness through Birnin Zana and met up with two of the People's allies, Zeke Stane and Vanisher, and teleported away with them. Zenzi later joined forces with Doctor Faustus and helped him and Baron Zemo take control of the minds of Wakanda's soldiers so Hydra could force Black Panther to hand over the Cosmic Cube fragment he had hidden away. Zenzi was later recruited by Bast to help the weakened goddess retake her power, which had been stolen by Emperor N'Jadaka, and after doing so became the goddess' new host.

When she was about to be killed by the troops of the late Erik Killmonger in the edge of a mass grave, she managed to affect her would-be executors and make them kill each other. thumb|left|Zenzi empathically manipulating Wakandans Zenzi became the leader of the Nigandan Army, and allied herself with Tetu, the head of the Wakandan rebel movement known as the People, and used her abilities to incite riots. The Black Panther tracked her down two times. The first time, in the Nigandan Border Region, Zenzi made her escape while the Black Panther fell prey to her abilities. The second time, Black Panther and his Hatut Zeraze ambushed Zenzi, Tetu and several Nigandan soldiers in Southwest Wakanda. During the scuffle, Black Panther knocked out Zenzi, causing her to slip into a coma. Tetu retreated with her and managed to wake her up several days later. Zenzi helped Tetu establish friendly terms with a coexisting rebel force, the Dora Milaje, by using her powers to thwart an attack of Black Panther's Hatut Zeraze. Zenzi later used her abilities to empower the members of the Nigandian Army and have them march towards the Golden City in their final act to overthrow Black Panther. When the People approached the Golden City, Black Panther had old scholar Changamire speak out against Tetu and broadcast it through the Kimoyo Beads. His speech moved countless members of the People's army, which in turn caused the effect of freeing them from Zenzi's grasp. Tetu had her use those few who remained on their side to murder the would-be defectors. She then empowered the remaining soldiers, turning them into mindless brutes that managed to break into the Golden City. Zenzi remained behind the People's forces, so she was not captured when Tetu and his soldiers fell at the hands of Black Panther and his allies, and instead observed from a distance as her enterprise collapsed. Zenzi retreated towards the wilderness through Birnin Zana and met up with two of the People's allies, Zeke Stane and Vanisher, and teleported away with them. Zenzi later joined forces with Doctor Faustus and helped him and Baron Zemo take control of the minds of Wakanda's soldiers so Hydra could force Black Panther to hand over the Cosmic Cube fragment he had hidden away. Zenzi was later recruited by Bast to help the weakened goddess retake her power, which had been stolen by Emperor N'Jadaka, and after doing so became the goddess' new host.
weapons: thumb|right
fields.notes: Using his Soul-Stalker technology, T'Challa classified Zenzi as a "metahuman", "domain: mentis dominus", "aura: chaos", "appellation: unknown".

zephyr zog.name: Zephyr Zog
zephyr zog.origin: Zephyr Zog was a famous German astrophysicist and string theorist who first learned how to breach the barriers between realities. It was for this reason that the Nazis of Earth-12591 did not turn Zog into a zombie, they needed his motor neurons not to be decomposed so that he could build a trans-dimensional battleship for the Nazi zombies to use in order to spread their infection across the Multiverse. When Zog realized the horrific destruction that the zombies planned to spread across countless universes, he informed A.R.M.O.R. on Earth-616, sending them video footage of the zombies destructive bloodlust. This prompted A.R.M.O.R. to recruit a team of superhumans led by Howard the Duck to go to Earth-12591 and stop the Nazi zombie threat from crossing over into Earth-616's reality. The Ducky Dozen, as the team was known, were led to Zog by this reality's last resistance to the Nazi zombie regime known as the Suffragists. After escaping from Zog's headquarters before being captured by a zombified Dum Dum Dugan, the group boarded Zog's private train and headed towards the Nazi zombies inner sanctum, determined to destroy their trans-dimensional battleship. While travelling to the zombies' headquarters in the Bavarian Alps, Zog and Ducky Dozen member Flexo acted as the train's engineers when they were attacked by a group of zombified Asgardian Valkyrior who were searching for Loki, who had secretly hidden aboard the train. The Valkyrie pinned Flexo to his seat with her spear before killing Zog.

zephyrus jones.name: Zephyrus Jones
zephyrus jones.origin: Zephyr Jones wanted to honor his father Dr. Morrison Jones' hopes of reaching the planet Mars by completing his father's rocket project after his death. Accompanied by his friend Corky Grogan, he would launch his rocket into space. Along the way however, their instruments would malfunction and instead they would be forced to land on the previous unknown planet of Sunev. They would be welcomed by the ruling Birdmen learning that the planet used to be part of Earth. After meeting with King Bolo, Zephyr and Corky would exchange knowledge and Zephyr would fall in love with Princess Tonka. The jealous General Roudo, seeking to turn over the Birdmen's longevity elixir to the evil Parrotmen would frame Zephyr and Corky as spies and the two would be locked up to await execution. When the Parrotmen would attack the Bird-People, Princess Tonka would bring Zephyr and Corky their guns and help free them. The duo would then fight off the Parrotmen and capture Roudo, exposing him as the true spy. After Roudo was executed, Zephyr would teach the Birdmen how to make guns and return home to Earth with Corky, to plan a second mission to Mars. Zephyr's second attempt to fly to Mars would also get sidetracked when Regean Lexico and his daughter Tesi would stow away on his ship and force them to redirect their rocket to the star known as Cygni. Learning that Lexico sought "Star Dust" a replacement for Radium as a fuel source, Zephyr would agree to go. Upon their arrival they would be attacked by the dwarfish Cygnians and the Lexico's would be captured. Zephyr and Corky would come to their rescue, freeing them and burying their Cygnian attackers under tons of rock. Collecting 50 pounds of "Star Dust" to return to Earth, they would head for home. Zephyr Jones has not been seen or heard from since, his fate remains unrevealed.
abilities: Zephyr is a capable inventor and rocket pilot
weapons: Zephyr sometimes arms himself with twin pistols.

zerhu.name: Zerhu
zerhu.origin: Not much is known about the past of the man called Zerhu. In 1945 he took leadership of a religious order called the Zurashnu that worshiped the goddess Vurashnu. He had claimed that he was Vurashnu's son and convinced his followers to turn over their valuables to Vurashnu as a sacrificial offering. Unknown to his followers, Zerhu took the possessions for his own material wealth. When one of their members refused to give up his valuables, Zerhu had him killed and when his daughter rebelled he sent his people to eliminate her as well. Their attempt to kill the girl was interrupted by the Angel who managed to convince Zerhu to let the girl go. Learning of the goings on within the group, the Angel agreed to help the woman expose Zerhu as a fraud. They were captured by Zehru and his men to be tortured, but both managed to break free. Being chased to the shrine to Vurashnu, the Angel kept the followers at bay until the woman found the stash of stolen jewels and valuables. Showing them to her fellow believers convinced them of Zehru's double crossing and his former followers then killed him in retribution in such a way it even unnerved the Angel.

zero kurarkill.name: Zero (Kurarkill)
zero kurarkill.origin: thumb|left|Before being transformed Zero was an unnamed former assistant of Dr. Kurarkill. When Kurarkill began experimenting on human and apes to create super intelligent apes at the cost of turning the humans into animals, Zero strongly disagreed with what Kurarkill was doing. In response, Kurarkill turned her into a cat and she somehow escaped and was adopted by Keith and Carrie who gave her the name Zero. When Keith, Carrie, and Iron Man became captives of Dr. Kurarkill and imprisoned in an electrical field, Zero generated sufficient static to disrupt the field, freeing the prisoners. Later, Zero chewed through some of the wires to the gate to Neo-Apes, causing a short that opened the wrong door and the apes seemingly killed the doctor. Zero's fate after this is currently unknown and is presumably still a cat since no one else knew of her transformation.

zet krill.name: Zet Krill
zet krill.species: Alien infected and turned into a Brood
zet krill.origin: Zet Krill was from an alien race from an unidentified planet. He and his parents went out to explore the galaxy in search of new planets to colonize. During their travels they encountered a distress signal and went to investigate. They discovered the signal was a trap by a Brood-Infested Acanti, and attempted to flee but their vessel was boarded. Zet, his sibling and mother were infected and transformed into Brood, his father Tyrus was similarly infected but was able to inject himself with a depressant which suppressed the infection. Ulara then left in the escape pod. Eventually Zet and her brood nest took root on Earth in the Hotel Ripley on Earth, bringing them up against Wolverine and a vengeful Tyrus. After they managed to take out all the Brood, Krill left himself transform into a Brood, tricking Wolverine into killing him. As Krill lay dying he revealed the full truth to Wolverine, who laid Krill with his dying family. Wolverine returned their bodies to the ship and with Beast's help they returned the ship to their homeworld.

They subdued the Hulk before killing Zgorian and leaving. zgreb.name: Zgreb
zgreb.species: Celestial turned into a Dark Celestial by the Horde
zgreb.origin: Zgreb is a Celestial who may or may not have originated during the time of the First Cosmos; however, what is known is that Celestials' counterparts across the Multiverse are interconnected aspects of themselves and not separate beings. Thus, the Zgreb of Earth-616 is one aspect of the true Zgreb. ===Earth-616=== Zgreb the Aspirant was a Celestial that came to Earth a million years ago in search of his fellow Celestial, the Progenitor. Upon finding the Progenitor, the Fallen became inflicted with the same Horde that affected it, causing him to become deranged. He was eventually defeated by the Avengers of the Stone Age and buried deep underground in what would become the modern-day country of South Africa, bound by powerful spells. In modern times, a team of archaeologists uncovered the underground cavern where Zgreb had been sealed into, leading to their deaths at the hands of the Celestial. Later, Loki, the Asgardian God of Mischief, released Zgreb from his prison and used him bring about the Final Host of Dark Celestials, so that a threat of their magnitude would reassemble the modern-day Avengers. Some of Earth's heroes attempted to fend off the invaders to no avail. Captain America used Alpha Flight's Omega-Level Warp Grenades to teleport the Dark Celestials to the Sun in an an attempt to destroy them, but it failed. They returned to Earth and traveled to the North Pole, where Loki showed Captain America the corpse of the Progenitor, a Celestial infected by the Horde who had fallen on Earth four billion years into the past. In the meantime, the Dark Celestials started bringing about the Earth's end, causing the ocean to boil and setting the air on fire. The Ghost Rider tracked down the Dark Celestials. He rescued Captain America and abducted Loki, prompting the Dark Celestials to chase after them. All of the heroes convened in Sweden shortly afterwards. Black Panther and Captain Marvel charged themselves with the same energy as the Horde, which allowed them go toe-to-toe against the insects. She-Hulk and Thor harnessed the power of the Blood of Ymir they had retrieved from Asgard. Ghost Rider used his powers to take hold of a dead Celestial's armor. Finally, Iron Man suited up on the Godkiller Armor MK II. Despite their combined strength, the Avengers failed to overpower the Dark Celestials, and in the middle of the battle, the Horde revived the bodies of the Celestials they had infected and felled. After learning of the connection between the Progenitor's death, the Horde and the genetic makeup of humankind, Iron Man rallied the Avengers to join their energies to form a Uni-Mind, since he had been passed on the secrets on how to summon it by Ikaris while investigating the Dark Celestials' arrival. Using the Ghost Rider as a conduit for the Uni-Mind, the Avengers rendered the Horde dormant, reviving the zombified Celestials. The Avengers and the Celestials combined their forces and defeated the Dark Celestials. The Dark Celestials were subsequently apprehended by the Celestials and teleported away from Earth.
powers: As an average Celestial, he possessed enough durability to withstand the flames of the Phoenix Force whose host claimed could melt a supernova as well as a blow from a flying Mjolnir.

zhao tang.name: Zhao Tang
zhao tang.origin: ===China Force=== At an early age, after each manifesting mutant powers, twins Zhao and Jhimon Tang were selected by the Chinese Communist government for training in the use of their mutants abilities . Upon completion of their training, both siblings were to join China's government-sponsored super team, officially dubbed China Force. The team was to function as an internal line of Chinese defense, as well as an answer the perceived threats of the government sponsored teams in the United States, the Soviet Union, and others. ===Hong Kong Scheme=== However, under as yet unreported circumstances, China Force was splintered by several defections, sparking Zhao and Jhimon (also called Auric and Silver, respectively) to also flee the country, into then-British Hong Kong. In Hong Kong, Silver and Auric became involved in an attempt to overthrow the government to prevent the planned absorption of Hong Kong to China. That scheme was thwarted partly due to the efforts of freelance international intelligence agent Rick Mason. ===Gamma Flight=== Silver and Auric defected to Canada, calling themselves Zhao and Jhimon Tang. The Canadian government offered them citizenship in exchange for working with Gamma Flight II, led by the second Nemesis. The twins, with the rest of Gamma Flight, fought their predecessors, Alpha Flight, although this was part of a plan by the evil Llan the Sorcerer. Once free of the Sorcerer's influence, Nemesis' Gamma Flight soon disbanded by the government in order to re-sanction Alpha Flight. Silver and Auric joined the newly created Beta Flight. ===Auctioned Off=== Shortly after joining Beta Flight, the two were kidnapped by the Sphinx, and they both died while being experimented on. The villain team known as the Chess Set hoped to auction the power-filled corpses of Silver and Auric, inviting criminals of all types to the Sphinx's base. The auction was interrupted by the hero team The New Warriors and Spider-Man, and the Sphinx's base was destroyed. fields.history: ===China Force=== At an early age, after each manifesting mutant powers, twins Zhao and Jhimon Tang were selected by the Chinese Communist government for training in the use of their mutants abilities . Upon completion of their training, both siblings were to join China's government-sponsored super team, officially dubbed China Force. The team was to function as an internal line of Chinese defense, as well as an answer the perceived threats of the government sponsored teams in the United States, the Soviet Union, and others. ===Hong Kong Scheme=== However, under as yet unreported circumstances, China Force was splintered by several defections, sparking Zhao and Jhimon (also called Auric and Silver, respectively) to also flee the country, into then-British Hong Kong. In Hong Kong, Silver and Auric became involved in an attempt to overthrow the government to prevent the planned absorption of Hong Kong to China. That scheme was thwarted partly due to the efforts of freelance international intelligence agent Rick Mason. ===Gamma Flight=== Silver and Auric defected to Canada, calling themselves Zhao and Jhimon Tang. The Canadian government offered them citizenship in exchange for working with Gamma Flight II, led by the second Nemesis. The twins, with the rest of Gamma Flight, fought their predecessors, Alpha Flight, although this was part of a plan by the evil Llan the Sorcerer. Once free of the Sorcerer's influence, Nemesis' Gamma Flight soon disbanded by the government in order to re-sanction Alpha Flight. Silver and Auric joined the newly created Beta Flight. ===Auctioned Off=== Shortly after joining Beta Flight, the two were kidnapped by the Sphinx, and they both died while being experimented on. zharkah.name: Zharkah
zharkah.origin: Zharkah was born in a planet governed by a strict caste system resulting from the interference of the Celestials. The Chosen were those gifted with magnificent abilities but no physical deviance, while the Rejects displayed phenotypical differences among themselves. As a Reject, Zharkah knew nothing but violence and disdain from the ruling class of Chosen, who saw her people as invalid and inferior creatures. In constant war with her opponents, she became a valuable leadership figure of the Djade tribe. Tragically, she saw many of her offspring not survive birth. When the group of alien mutants known as X-Factor were dragged onto her planet as a result of the machinations of the Celestials, Zharkah met Beast, who she believed to be one of the Rejects. X-Factor was separated due to the intervention of the Celestial Gammenon and Beast joined the Rejects in their city. Having developed a strong connection with Beast, Zharkah was shocked to learn about the different members of X-Factor. Despite displaying loyalty, she was unable to reveal to her new ally she kept his teammate Jean Grey captive. Zharkah specifically kept the information to test if Beast was a Reject or not. Upon finding Jean Grey being transported, he attempted to free her, prompting Zharkah to judge him as a traitorous infiltrator. Beast was caged, but managed to escape. As he attempted to escape, it was revealed to Zharkah that Beast came from another planet, thus not being either a Reject or a Chosen. Knowing Beast's true intentions, Zharkah and the Djade tribe supported him in his quest to reunite X-Factor. Zharkah led the Rejects into the citadel of the Chosen to end their ruthless and corrupted rule, implemented by the vile Palik. As the Celestials judged and threatened the planet, Zharkah decided to have the Rejects join the Chosen, X-Factor and all other factions to protect their existence. She made the difficult decision to embrace change and different ideologies to prosper in battle. This caused the Celestials to leave the planet and a united community was able to thrive in peace.
abilities: Entropy, capable of blowing things up from the inside out, as he did with the head of an enemy who tried to take it from behind.

zheng yi.name: Zheng Yi
zheng yi.origin: ===Origins=== Zheng Yi and his older brother Zheng Zu were powerful sorcerers born during the 18th century Qing Dynasty in China. The two brothers and their five disciples, the Deadly Warriors, formed the Five Weapons Society to protect China. Through the use of longevity spells, Yi and Zu lived decades beyond their natural lifespans, outliving their original disciples and leaving them old and weak during the Opium Wars in the next century. During a battle with the British Army, the Five Weapons Society suffered a horrible defeat by Dormammu and his Mindless Ones, resulting in the deaths of the then current lineup of Deadly Warriors and Yi receiving mortal wounds. With the Eyes of the Dragon, Zu attempted to revive his brother and restore his youth at the cost of his own life, but Yi reversed the spell due to not wanting the rule the Society alone, sacrificing himself to restore Zu's youth and power. Zu led the Society alone from then, but without his kind hearted brother's influence he became increasingly ruthless and corrupt, transforming the Society into a vast criminal empire. To instill fear, Zu lied about Yi's death, claiming he murdered Yi for his perceived weakness and stole his life energy to augment his own. ===Life Beyond Death=== Zheng Yi appeared to his nephew Shang-Chi as a spirit, urging him to visit his tomb in Henan. At Yi's tomb, Shang-Chi requested his uncle's guidance in stopping his sister Shi-Hua and for a cure for his wound inflicted by the jiangshi created by her. Instead, Yi told his nephew to stop running away from his family and revealed the truth of Zheng Zu's past. Shang-Chi recalled Yi's words while fighting Shi-Hua, which prevented him from being mutated into a jiangshi.

zheng zhilan.name: Zheng Zhilan
zheng zhilan.origin: One of the many daughters of the sorcerer and crimelord Zheng Zu, Zhilan was raised in the House of the Deadly Staff outside of London, England. When Zhilan sought to reform the Five Weapons Society, Zheng Zu ordered Brother Sabre to assassinate her for her insolence. Instead, Brother Sabre spared Zhilan and faked her death. Unbeknownst to the two half-siblings, the real reason why their father ordered Zhilan's death was due to her status as a mutant, a species that Zu believed had the potential to become a dangerous colonial threat. During her exile, Zhilan took up residence in in Ireland, where she used her mutant abilities to assist the locals, earning the reputation as the "Witch of Muckross Lake". Her actions were eventually captured on social media, prompting the new Supreme Commander of the Society and her half-brother Shang-Chi to seek her out. Believing Shang-Chi, Brother Sabre, and Sister Dagger came to kill her, Zhilan attacked them; the fight was interrupted by Wolverine, who revealed Zhilan's existence as a mutant and attempted to bring her to Krakoa for her protection. After a prolonged struggle, Shang-Chi was able to clear up the misunderstanding with Wolverine and Zhilan. Realizing that Shang-Chi had implemented the same reforms that she sought for the Society, Zhilan politely turned down Wolverine's invitation to Krakoa and accepted Shang's offer to rejoin the Society as its new Sister Staff. Wolverine held off a mob of anti-mutant protestors while Zhilan escaped with her half-siblings to the House of the Deadly Hand in New York. While resting in her private quarters, Zhilan was visited by Chieftain Xin, who offered her a proposal. Sister Staff accompanied Shang-Chi and her siblings when they broke into the Baxter Building to gain access to the Negative Zone, casting a mind numbing spell to incapacitate the building's staff and guests and destroyed the H.E.R.B.I.E.s guarding Mister Fantastic's lab with her solidified music. In the Negative Zone, Sister Staff and her siblings met Jiang Li, Shang-Chi's mother, for the first time and brought her back to Earth, where they got into an altercation with the Fantastic Four. Sister Staff briefly fought against Invisible Woman before escaping with her family back to the House of the Deadly Hand. Sister Staff later joined up with several former allies-turned-enemies of the Society, including King Wild Man, Lady Iron Fan and Red Dot, who were recruited by Xin where he revealed his plans to bring an end to Shang-Chi's rule. While at the House of the Deadly Sabre with her siblings, Sister Staff saw Shang-Chi get confronted by several of his superhero allies who demanded he hand over a Cosmic Cube they believed he stole and came to his aid when the confrontation turned violent. While he fought Thor, Shang-Chi realized Brother Sabre had stolen the Cube and lied to him about it, prompting him to hand Takeshi over to the heroes as a prisoner along with the Cube. Zhilan later met with Xin and informed him of the events that had transpired. Zhilan later joined Xin's allies during their assault against Shang-Chi at the New House of the Deadly Hand, revealing to all her betrayal was due to her belief that Shang-Chi cared more about his western allies than his family when he handed Brother Sabre to the Avengers. However, this turned out to be a ruse and Zhilan helped Shang-Chi and the Society defeat the would-be assassins, admitting to Shang-Chi that his actions with Takeshi proved that he held to his principles above all else, earning her trust as leader. Unfortunately, the assassins took Jiang Li hostage, forcing Shang-Chi to release them and regrouping with Xin, taking a portal to Qilin Island. When Shang-Chi agreed with Xin to exchange his life for Jiang Li's, Sister Staff accompanied him and Sister Dagger to the Mauna Kea summit in Hawai'i for the exchange, where Staff promised to care for Jiang Li as her own mother after getting her back. Xin and the Qilin Riders arrived without Jiang Li and attacked the three siblings. When Shang-Chi was able to fight him off, Xin resorted to using some of Shang-Chi's blood to create three taotie before fleeing back to Ta-Lo. Sister Staff and her siblings defeated one taotie and saved Falo from the second one. While researching the taotie, the siblings realized that Xin created them to hunt anyone in Zheng Zu's lineage and that Falo was a descendant of their father. Falo attempted to make a pass at Sister Staff but was threatened by Dagger, revealing that Staff was related to him as his ancestor was her father. Sister Staff traveled with her siblings to the Vault where they saved Takeshi from the third taotie. When Shang-Chi received a vision of Shi-Hua getting attacked by Xin, he freed Brother Sabre from the Vault's guardsmen despite Sister Staff's reminder of staying true to his principles, and the four traveled to British Columbia to rescue Sister Hammer after she was left for dead by Xin. The five Champions of the Five

zhilla char.name: Zhilla Char
zhilla char.origin: Not much is known about Zhilla aside from the circumstances leading to her death. Approximately 800 years ago, when wandering the Astral Plane to digest the essence stolen from her victims, she wandered close to Nightmare's realm, attracting his attention. The predator became a victim, as Nightmare forced himself upon her, impregnating her in the process. Nightmare then left her in a lower realm from which she was unable to escape. Succubi mothers are replaced by their children, and so Zhilla's body burned away. In place was left her daughter, who inherited all of her mother's memories.

zhou man she.origin: Zaran, also known as Zhou Man She, is a formidable mercenary and assassin, highly skilled in both armed and unarmed combat. His journey has led him to numerous conflicts with various heroes across the globe, particularly Shang-Chi. Initially trained by Maximillian Zaran, Zhou Man She eventually surpassed his master and assumed the identity of Zaran . He was later hired by Shadow-Hand to recover Fu Manchu’s reliquary, a container believed to hold a map to the Elixir Vitae . This mission put him at odds with Clive Reston and Black Jack Tarr, as well as Shang-Chi . Zaran played a pivotal role during the Burundan civil war, operating under General Bushman as the leader of one of his deadly squads . Later, he was tasked with infiltrating an A.I.M. facility to steal the Z99 chemical agent for Fu Manchu, eliminating multiple operatives in the process . Following this, Fu Manchu ordered Zaran and Dacoits to assassinate Shang-Chi, promising him great rewards. Zaran tracked him down and killed the family Shang-Chi was living with at the time . The two engaged in an intense battle that spanned Canal Street, ending with Zaran’s capture by the police . Despite his imprisonment, Zaran managed to escape using a concealed dart to unlock his restraints . However, his failure to eliminate Shang-Chi displeased Fu Manchu, who sent agents Mr. Lu and Zingh to execute him . Zaran fought back but was eventually subdued. Rather than killing him, Fu Manchu granted him one last chance to complete his mission . Zaran later led an attack on the Marvel Knights headquarters, bringing him into direct combat with Shang-Chi, Moon Knight, and Daredevil . Though he fought fiercely, he was eventually bested by Shang-Chi . In the chaos following an explosion, Zaran attempted to escape but fell from a skyscraper, barely managing to survive . During the events of Secret Wars, Zaran was captured by Emila Vachon and subjected to mind-control technology, forcing him into a docile, repetitive behavioral state under the alias Mr. Muscatel . He was later freed when Misty Knight and Colleen Wing disrupted the control mechanism .

ziran.name: Ziran
ziran.origin: ===Celestial War=== Predating the Multiverse by many times over, Ziran was one of the Celestials from the First Cosmos, the first-ever universe. They rebelled against their creator, the First Firmament, and the Aspirants, shattering the First Cosmos into the Second Cosmos, the first-ever Multiverse. This began the multiversal cycles. The Celestials created and/or appointed many beings to serve them, including but not limited to the Exterminators, Cal-Horra, and the Omegas. Each time the Multiverse ended, the Celestials passed on to the next incarnation of the Multiverse. At some point, the Celestials also began to assign Kings in Black. Although split across the Multiverse, the Celestials' counterparts are interconnected aspects of themselves and not separate beings. Thus, the Ziran of Earth-616 is one aspect of the true Ziran. ===Knull=== Following many multiversal cycles, Ziran and the other Celestials began the creation of the Seventh Cosmos and attempted to recruit Knull, a primordial god of darkness who ruled over the Void that had been formed by the Sixth Cosmos' destruction, to be their King in Black, but he rejected the responsibility. When Knull killed one of Ziran's comrades, the Celestials retaliated by banishing Knull back into the void, though he eventually returned to wage war on them. To oppose him, the Celestials created the Enigma Force. ===Earth-616=== A Celestial that tests the stability of genes and such in the lifeforms they have evolved. He sends them through a series of tests until they are ready to go back to the planet to start their new lives. ===Multiverse=== The Celestials exist across the Multiverse simultaneously. A Celestial's alternate reality selves are actually aspects of the same being. Despite this, their alternate aspects may have very different histories from the ones in the mainstream Marvel Universe. ====Earth-8101==== thumb|none Ziran the Tester was one of the Celestials who visited Earth-8101. ====Earth-9997==== thumb|none Ziran is a member of the Celestial race. Having long since evolved past physical bodies, the Celestials reproduced by impregnating a planet with their essence, which in time would gestate into an infant Celestial. To protect the growing fetus, they would genetically modify the people of said world, greatly enhancing their evolutionary potential and imbuing them with a certain level of aggressiveness. One of these impregnated planets was Earth. After the populace of Earth fully mutated prematurely, Ziran and other Celestials travelled to the world to purge it of all life before they could threaten the infant Celestial. They were met with opposition from Black Bolt on the Moon, Ziran and the Celestials would kill Black Bolt and then set their sights on Earth. On Earth, they would be opposed by Namor and an army of sea creatures, Tony Stark in a giant robotic factor and an army of Iron Men robots, and an army of Asgardians led by Loki. This bought the Earth precious moments for the arrival of "Galactus" (actually Franklin Richards) who was called to Earth by Black Bolt before his death. Galactus was able to fight off the Celestials, and Ziran was one of the Celestials felled in the battle. ====Earth-17628==== thumb|none Ziran the Tester was one of the Celestials who attempted to bring light to the universe but found themselves up against Knull. They were defeated after Knull created the Klyntar to be used against them. It is unknown if Ziran was killed or was one of the few who survived and fled to the farthest reaches of space. ====Earth-21443==== thumb|none Ziran the Tester and other Celestials were briefly seen millions of years in the past, during the time of the Dinosaurs by Kang the Conqueror when he was travelling through the time stream looking for Black Panther. ====Earth-89721==== thumb|none Ziran the Tester was one of the Celestials who came to Earth and judged humanity unworthy. The evolved humans joined their minds in one and killed Arishem the Judge which prompted the other Celestials to leave Earth alone. ====Earth-90251==== thumb|none Ziran and all of the Celestials were killed by Doctor Doom in a battle that lasted 407 years, after Doom gained the power of the Beyonder and the Infinity Gauntlet. ====Earth-90266==== thumb|none Ziran, along with many Abstract Entities, tried to stop Thanos after he activated the Infinity Gauntlet. Ziran's armor was later piloted by Iron Man to fight Thanos, while using it to channel the power Negative Zone. After Thanos was defeated by the New Fantastic Four and Spider-Man acquired the Infinity Gauntlet, all of those killed by Thanos (save Mephisto), were resurrected, including Ziran. ====Earth-95397==== thumb|none Ziran was one of the many Cosmic Beings who assembled to reclaim the Infinity Gauntlet from the Impossible Man. ====Earth-16524==== thumb|none ====Earth-TRN909==== thumb|none Ziran was killed alongside the universe's galactic empires, Galactus, and the other Celestials by Annihilus during hi
powers: Ziran can telekinetically move planets and hurl them at opponents in battle. Ziran's armor can withstand attacks that pulverize planets without any damage. The armor can channel the power of the entire Negative Zone.

zmora.name: Zmora
zmora.origin: Zmora is one of the twin siblings known as the Night Terrors, born from the union between the Fear Lord Nightmare and Nemesis, the first nightmare ever dreamt. At some point, Zmora and her twin Morus were chained and hidden away by their father. Zmora and Morus were eventually released by Nightmare during his battle against Wiccan, Somnus, and the Sorcerer Supreme Scarlet Witch within Billy Kaplan's dreamscape. After the Scarlet Witch destroyed their cauldron, the Night Terrors subjected Wanda, Wiccan, and Somnus to a "poison peace," forcing them to relive their worst moments and turning their lives into despair and accusation. However, after Somnus temporarily awakened the people of the waking world, Nightmare became linked to humanity's collective consciousness, weakening him and giving the Night Terrors an opportunity to devour their father. In response, the Scarlet Witch and Wiccan cast a spell that manipulated humanity's ancient belief that salt repels evil and nightmares, using it against Nightmare and the Night Terrors, overwhelming them and knocking Nightmare unconscious. The Scarlet Witch then allowed the Night Terrors to retreat with their father rather than kill him.

family: Morus (twin brother) Dreamqueen (half-sister) Daydream (half-sister) Terrance Ward (half-brother)

zoe culloden.name: Zoe Culloden
zoe culloden.origin: An orphan girl was recruited out of an orphanage by Chang, an agent of the firm Landau, Luckman, & Lake. Chang ensured she received an education, and even provided her with a new identity - Zoe Culloden, "named for an and a " - before getting her a job with the company. Zoe excelled, becoming known internally as an employee who could swiftly fulfill the needs of the firm and their clients - an expediter. As an adult, she investigated the death of Chang. She first suspected his friend and client, Logan, but after further investigation she relented, and settled into her role as the manager of his account with the firm. Later, Zoe worked another case. The firm's precognitives had predicted the ascension of a cosmic messiah they called "The Mithras" who was supposed to herald a galaxy-wide cultural rebirth, and the firm concluded that Deadpool was that cosmic messiah, so Zoe was then assigned to expedite this prophecy.
abilities: Accomplished , athlete, hand-to-hand combatant, actress, and accent/dialect mimicker.

zoe walsh.name: Zoe Walsh
zoe walsh.origin: The mentally unstable daughter of Roxxon CEO David Walsh. After years of hearing about her father's unethical experimental practices and his use of human traffickers to obtain test subjects, she set off a missile on the roof of Roxxon headquarters, getting thrown by the blast and caught by Scarlet Spider. Grateful to the hero for saving her, Zoe took him home and had sex with him, but when she claimed she was the one who fired the missile, Kaine left. Shortly after her, Zoe was brought by her father. Kaine, managed to escape the Rangers and took Zoe away with him. The girl told him that her father was doing something illegal in Galveston and promised to show him and although at first it seemed there was nothing wrong, it was later revealed that Zoe had been telling the truth. Shortly thereafter the demon Mammon (which Zoe's father wanted to use as a power source) broke loose on the platform and as the Scarlet Spider and the Rangers battled him, David arrived on the scene to kill the heroes and take his daughter to the asylum. When Mammon tried to steal Zoe's body, David prevented him, but was possessed in her stead. Kaine managed to free him, but the man ended up in a coma and Zoe seeing her act of love towards her, forgave him and decided to take revenge on Kaine, holding him responsible for the conditions of her father. Months later Zoe's hired men finally found out that Kaine lived at the Four Seasons and Zoe went there immediately, blowing up Kaine's room with a bazooka shot. Zoe and the other occupants of the room were thrown out of the blast, but Kaine managed to save everyone with cobwebs. Considering that police officer Wally Layton was also on the scene, it is likely that Zoe was arrested and interned.
abilities: Drawing: Zoe is very good at drawing, as she created a perfect identikit of Kaine.
weapons: Rocket launcher
weaknesses: Mental instability: Zoe is clearly insane and unable to think clearly.

zofia dracula.name: Zofia Dracula
zofia dracula.first_appearance: Giant-Size Chillers Featuring Curse of Dracula Vol 1 1
zofia dracula.origin: Zofia was the first wife of Count Dracula, a Hungarian noblewoman, her marriage arranged by Dracula's father. Although Dracula absolutely despised Zofia, they had a child together named Lilith and the fact that he was given a female heir infuriated Dracula even more. Dracula routinely abused Zophia mentally and physically, while he had affairs with many women. Eventually, Dracula's treatment of Zophia worsened to the point where he could not even bare to stand her. After his father died, he stripped her of her royal title and demanded that she leave the castle with Lilith. Distraught, Zophia turned Lilith over to a gypsy woman named Gretchen to raise. With her daughter cared for, Zophia committed suicide in grief over her life situation. Zofia was survived by Lilith, who was in later years turned into a vampire even more powerful than Dracula (and without the same weaknesses and limitations of her father) by Gretchen as revenge against the cruel vampire king. Over the centuries, Lilith often plagued her father in revenge for his treatment of her mother those many centuries ago.

zoltan amadeus.name: Zoltan Amadeus
zoltan amadeus.first_appearance: Spider-Man and His Amazing Friends Season 3 4
zoltan amadeus.origin: Zoltan is a chemical scientist who creates a Spider-Serum that will give him Spider-Powers. He impersonates Spider-Man when committing crimes until he mutates into the Arachnoid: a mutant with the torso of a man and a spider's body from the waist down. Zoltan went on a crime spree with Spider-Man’s powers and his costume, blaming Spider-Man for his crimes. The serum later began having a strange effect on both him and Spider-Man as their spider-senses started jamming one another’s, and Zoltan later turned into a giant Spider. After battling with the Spider-Friends, Spider-Man managed to give Zoltan the antidote to his original formula, turning him into a human once again.

zoltar.name: Zoltar
zoltar.origin: Zoltar was a Fortisquian who was born on Arcturus IV more than ten thousand years ago and was a member of the small Fortisquian colony that existed on that planet. Zoltar was part of the crew of a starship called The Comet that was sent on an expedition to Earth ten thousand years ago but a crashlanding left Kammar, Ular and Zoltar as the only three survivors. The purpose of the expedition had been to save an animal preserve that was threatened by a failure of its environmental systems due to damage caused by the Great Cataclysm. The three survivors managed to repair the damage and then found a teleportation warp that took them back to Arcturus IV. Discovering their homeworld in ruins following a war that had occurred during their absence, the three returned to Earth. Finding the planet to be inhabited by primitive humans, Zoltar and the others decided to teach them and guide their evolution into an intelligent species. In time, the three came to consider themselves to be humanity's Caretakers.
powers: Zoltar had a lifespan of over ten thousand years.

zomber.name: Zomber
zomber.origin: Zomber was a member of the Nazis who was active during World War II. By the fall of 1943 he and his minions were operating out of a secret hideout beneath a mountain in Sweet Lake City. With powerful electromagnets and a spy working as an air traffic controller at the local airport they caused many planes in the area to crash. After the fourth such crash, the United States Senate created a commission to investigate the crashes and had the poor judgement of sending them by plane to Sweet Lake City. Along with the government came the Human Torch and Toro who also took an interest in the mystery. When Zomber and his men attempted to crash the plane, the Torch and Toro saved it from crashing by using their flames to create a powerful updraft that kept the plane in the air until it could fly out of the magnet;s range. Finding the magnets protruding out of the ground in the woods, the two heroes melted through the ground into the Nazi base, clashing with Zomber and his men. Zomber kept the two heroes on the defense by using his magnets to keep a step ahead of the heroes. When he attempted to keep them at bay with a cannon that fired flame retarding fluids, the heroes promptly melted it and captured Zomber and his men. Taking them to the airport, they also apprehended the accomplice in air traffic control. As Zomber and his men were being handed over to the authorities, Zomber broke free and made a run to a nearby auto-gyro to escape. The Torch and Toro were forced to hurl fireballs at the plane, causing an explosion that killed Zomber.
weapons: Zomber had a Luger and also used a cannon that shot fire retardant fluids.

zombie howling commandos.name: Zombie (Howling Commandos)
zombie howling commandos.origin: Virtually nothing is known about the Howling Commandos operative referred to as "Zombie". Already clinically deceased at the time of his recruitment, even the highest ranking members of the Commandos and S.H.I.E.L.D. are unsure of his history prior to joining the team, or even his true name, though he is sometimes referred to as "John" or "John Doe" by his teammates. Zombie was one of the Commandos dispatched to prevent technological death-cult the Lords of the Living Lightning from selling advanced computer hacking software to terrorists outside of Afghanistan. After infiltrating the base, Zombie was able to have the Lords' computer mainframe erased by threatening to eat the two technicians guarding it. Zombie was later seen discussing the escape of Merlin from Area 13's containment warehouse with his teammates in the Area 13 cafeteria. When Merlin's forces invaded Area 13 via a magical portal, Zombie forcibly moved Bradley Beemer and his commanding officer Clay Quartermain to safety away from the battle, despite the latter's protests. Zombie then joined his teammates in their all-out assault on Merlin's encampment in England, where they easily defeated the wizard's forces. Zombie's current whereabouts are unknown, though he does not appear to be active with the current incarnation of the Howling Commandos.
weaknesses: The lack of information about his zombification also makes it impossible to know if Zombie has any natural weaknesses, or if he suffers from any of the usual weaknesses associated with the undead.

zombo.name: Zombo
zombo.origin: Zombo the Inhuman was a master hypnotist who owned his own island, amassing countless resources and an army of hypnotized slaves he sought to use a submarine to destroy any ships that happened to venture too close to his island. These destructive acts attracted the attention of Rockman who came up to the surface from his kingdom of Abysmia to stop Zombo's reign of terror. Rockman was briefly overpowered by Zombo's hypnotic power and forced to fall into his sub and battle his legion of slaves. Outnumbered, Rockman called on his fellow Abysmians to cause a massive tidal wave to wash out Zombo's island. The resulting tsunami destroyed Zombo's island and the villain was left to drown in the waters by Rockman.

zona cluster 6.name: Zona Cluster-6
zona cluster 6.species: Experiments conducted by the Weapon Plus program on Zona Cluster-6
zona cluster 6.origin: 150px|thumb|left Huntsman belonged to the latest generation of living weapons created by Weapon Plus Program, and was designated Weapon XII. Like Fantomex (Weapon XIII) he was born and artificially "evolved" in The World, a man-made environment designed to create Super-Soldiers using Sentinel technology. He was intended to be one of the Super-Sentinels, a team of mutant hunters conceived by John Sublime as a publicity stunt to make the extermination of mutants acceptable to the public. Huntsman, alongside Fantomex, was transported from England to France via the Euro Tunnel. However, a fake train wreck set up by Weapon Plus itself released both Fantomex and Huntsman from their containment capsules, while also trapping 120 passengers, 30 asylum-seekers and numerous animals within the Tunnel. Members of the X-Corporation Paris were dispatched to deal with the accident. While Darkstar, Siryn, Multiple Man, M, Rictor, and Cannonball were overwhelmed fighting Huntsman's possessed victims, Phoenix and Professor X were recruited by Fantomex in exchange for information on Weapon Plus. Professor X and Phoenix arrived to find the X-Corp members nearly defeated, with Siryn injured and Rictor, immune to Huntsman's infection, saved by Madrox. Phoenix's telekinetic powers were useless against Huntsman's. Professor X took over the mind of Madrox in order to create an army of mind-controlled duplicates to counter Huntsman's own army. Meanwhile, Fantomex shot his way through Huntsman's victims, including Darkstar herself, in order to reach the train that contained Huntsman's kill switch. Fantomex activated the kill switch, killing not only Huntsman but also all those whose minds were infected. When the military arrived, they eliminated all evidence of an anti-mutant conspiracy.
powers: Huntsman possessed a viral, hive-mind consciousness that caused anyone he touched to take on his mindset and drives. As Fantomex put it, he turns his enemies into himself.
weaknesses: Huntsman was implanted with a fail-safe device allowing his handlers to kill him instantly if necessary.

zoor.name: Zoor
zoor.origin: Zoor is a member of a race of aliens from the planet Ligra known as the Dragon-Men. He was the bodyguard of King Jago. After Jago kidnapped Earth scientist Professor Philo Zog and his robot Electro, he would set the robot to attack his foes the Lion-People. During the battle Zoor would accompany Jago in kidnapping Queen Nara, slaying Nara's guard Gor. Ultimately, Zog would free himself and turn Electro against Jaro and his minions, saving the queen. Zoor's ultimate fate is unrevealed, however it is entirely likely he was one of the many Dragon-Men slain in the battle against Electro, or drowned along with Jago when his escape ship was tossed into a lake by the robot.

zora loftus.origin: thumb|left|175px Working as a criminologist for the police department, Zora Loftus stole the technology belonging to the Vulture to create the identity of the Bluebird and began a series of robberies that caught the attention of the Spider-Man. Later, she went on a talk show hosted by Charlie Gladhand and taunted Spider-Man that he was probably working as a team with Bluebird and that he too was a criminal. Spider-Man attempted to apprehend Bluebird, but he failed. He tried a second time and managed to catch her this time by cutting off her means of escape with webbing. After getting caught in webbing in an alleyway, Spider-Man unmasked her and delivered her to the police.
weapons: Bluebird uses an ultrasonic device that emits a sonic attack with enough power to disorient someone and render them unconscious.

zora risman.name: Zora Risman
zora risman.origin: ===Origins=== Zora Risman was a teenager when she fought the mutants along her brother Matthew, as Apocalypse mutants confronted the X-Men in Philadelphia. She was raised tough by her brother, a violent anti-mutant bigot who even tried to make her kill a mutant kid during an operation where the pair became separated from the resistance and were going to take the Schuylkill River down to the Delaware: There, after killing his parents and brothers, Matthew left a gun between both the wounded mutant boy and Zora, and eventually shot the running kid when Zora stayed without acting. When he died, she became Deadeye. She eventually joined the X-Terminated, while clerking in the Mutant Powers Registration Center. ===The Dregs=== Following Weapon Omega's takeover as Overlord of their world, the X-Terminated continued their battle against the mutant oppressors. While working at the Mutant Powers Register Center, Deadeye became aware of anti-mutant pamphlets being circulated which were causing riots. Deadeye and the X-Terminated located the man responsible for writing the pamphlets, Harper Simmons, just in time to save him from Keeper Murdock and Omega's Hounds. While investigating one of Henry McCoy's abandoned laboratories, the X-Terminated were attacked by Clan Akkaba and in the ensuing fight, Deadeye was left behind and captured. While imprisoned, Deadeye was being transported to be interrogated by the Shadow King, which served as the perfect moment for her teammates Goodnight and Horror Show to attack and liberate their comrade. ===Salvation=== When the Lady Penance suddenly arrived in New Apocalypse and began rallying mutants to fight for a better world, Deadeye joined Prophet in eavesdropping on a subsequent meeting Penance had with Omega's ministers. After Penance released Colossus from Omega's influence and the other ministers took their leave, Prophet made himself known to Penance as Deadeye watched from a vantage point. Learning that Prophet was actually responsible for Penance's sudden appearance and that Prophet was willing to aid Penance in claiming power over Omega to the point of even offering her the X-Terminated's captured Sugar Man as a sign of good faith, Deadeye was disgusted and angered by Prophet's plans to gamble their future by replacing Omega with a mutant who may just as easily treat humanity as an inferior race. Despite her reservations, Deadeye personally delivered Sugar Man to Penance herself and made it known that she disagrees with Prophet's plan and that she doesn't trust Penance at all. ===Kiss of Doom=== In an effort to fight against Weapon Omega and his Celestial power, the X-Terminated went in search of Reed Richards' diaries, a quest which led them to the home of Victor von Doom in Latveria. Discovering Doom possessed the Master Apparatus, a machine capable of capturing the Death Seed and redirecting it to a new host, Prophet and Deadeye debated the possibility of working together with him. It was obvious Doom wished to redirect the power of the Death Seed to himself and succeed Weapon Omega as heir to Apocalypse despite his claims of good intentions. Through a series of manipulations and double crosses, Deadeye faked allegiance to Doom - appearing to betray the X-Terminated - and giving her the chance to get close enough to slay Doom as he slept. Deadeye took Doom's detached head as a means of harnessing the Master Apparatus and rejoined the X-Terminated, despite the fact she legitimately did believe in Doom's plan to overthrow Omega with a human successor. ===Requiem=== When Omega tracked down Jean Grey to the Morlock Tunnels and attempted to capture her, the X-Terminated launched an attack against Omega using Doom's Master Apparatus. During skirmishes in the tunnels, Omega managed to corner Jean but Sabretooth intervened allowing Jean to escape. Deadeye watched the entire fight between Omega and Sabretooth from a safe vantage point, and didn't intervene allowing Omega to apparently kill Sabretooth. As the battle raged on and the X-Terminated pushed their attack against Omega's forces, Deadeye was taken by surprise by Azazel, and although she eventually overcame him in a battle, she didn't emerge unscathed on account of Azazel having badly cut her arm. Deadeye and the X-Terminated eventually managed to defeat Weapon Omega and most of his forces were likewise defeated or fled. Following the overthrow of Omega, Deadeye was sent to investigate the activities of Penance whom was quick to rally fellow mutants upon Omega's defeat. Deadeye watched Penance's rally and was surprised to hear Penance acknowledge humans and making promises that would ensure they would not be persecuted. When two of Omega's remaining soldiers, Prelate Summers and Havok, arrived to attack Penance and her followers, Deadeye intervened and attempted to assassinate the Summers brothers. Havok discovered her location and used his powers to make the entire building of the roof she was on collapse, bring her down
powers: Photographic memory
abilities: Psi-proof training: Zora is used to masking her thoughts from telepaths using mental ruses. Marksman

zorak.name: Zorak
zorak.origin: Zorak was the leader of the Lizard Men of Tok, a planet which exists in the Microverse. His people sought to invade the realm of Sub-Atomica. They had an opportunity however of forging an alliance with Doctor Doom during a period when he ruled Sub-Atomica. This plan was quashed thanks to the interference of Doom's enemies the Fantastic Four and their ally Ant-Man. Years later Zorak sought to force Sub-Atomica's Queen Pearla to be his bride. Harboring a desire to invade Tok herself, Pearla instead challenged Zorak to a duel against her chosen champion, the Fantastic Four's Thing. In reality this battle was to be a distraction while Pearla sent an invasion fleet to Tok and decimate it. This scheme was uncovered by the new Ant-Man who was sent into the Microverse to rescue the Thing. When Ben was informed of what was happening, they defeated Zorak, and destroyed Pearla's fleet. Zorak and Pearla were then forced to sign a truce. Zorak's subsequent fate is unknown.

zoralis gupa.name: Zoralis Gupa
zoralis gupa.origin: Zoralis Gupa was a member of the Galactic Rim Collective native of the planet Silnius and its ambassador for the Galactic Council. He was present at a conference taking place in the Proscenium during which the Zn'rx representative and emperor Stote was killed. Rocket Raccoon investigated the murder and figured out that Sisterhood of Badoon ambassador Lani Ko Ako was in reality the Profiteer, who had killed Stote to spark a war of succession. During the investigation, Chitauri representative Peacebringer triggered a self-destruct mechanism. The Profiteer intended to let him detonate to cover her tracks, until Zoralis Gupa received the news that Slinus and many other planets in different territories had been destroyed by Knull's starfaring bloodthirsty rampage. After Zoralis relied the news, the Profiteer changed her mind and teleported herself away with Peacebringer, having decided the Galactic Council needed to survive to help their empires bounce back from Knull's attacks so they could keep affording her weapons.

zorba fortunov.name: Zorba Fortunov
zorba fortunov.origin: ===Youth=== Zorba Fortunov was the son of King Vladimir of Latveria and brother to Rudolfo, heir apparent to the throne. As a member of the royal family, Zorba was familiar with the rooms of several castles of Latveria including one that had been home of the hereditary rulers of the country, but had stopped to be. ===Doom takes Latveria=== King Vladimir was deposed and murdered by Victor von Doom (styled Doctor Doom), who usurped the Latverian throne and later murdered Rudolfo, who had become a leader of a resistance movement. Doom also captured Zorba and ordered his scientist Gustav Hauptmann to perform unethical experiments on Zorba's eye, leaving him blind in the right eye. The socket was filled in with a cybernetic implant which included an energy blast weapon, the Nega-Beam Blast. Doom was careful to include a specific shield on his omnipresent armor to protect him against this ray. Zorba eventually escaped or was released, keeping a personal grudge against Hauptmann and his family. thumb|left|Zorba is tortured ===Resistance Leader=== Zorba reappeared in the public scene, claiming the throne for himself and using persuasion to propel rebellion among the people. Zorba also replaced Rudolfo as the leader of the Latverian Freedom Fighters,, which numbered less than fifty individuals including a man named Koro, all of them hidden in a secret headquarters in the Latverian hills. Their goal was to replace Doom with Rudolfo's heir, then restore democracy in Latveria. They discovered, however, that Doom intended to follow the letter of the law and abdicate in favor of his supposed son Victor von Doom II, unknown to everyone until that moment. Zorba planned to stage a direct attack during the coronation ceremony. To that end, Zorba armed his men with weapons smuggled into Latveria. Doom's enemy Mister Fantastic, a superhero member of the Fantastic Four, sneaked into Latveria to confront Doom, but he was injured by one of Doom's border guard robots. Mr. Fantastic was found by resistance members and taken to their headquarters, where Zorba explained Doom's plan and recruited Mr. Fantastic for his cause. Mr. Fantastic convinced Zorba to forfeit his risky strategy and instead use his powers to ensure a stealth assault: Mr. Fantastic's elasticity allowed him to help Zorba's men climb a steep mountain, then hid them from Doom's Eye-Spy drone; lastly, Mr. Fantastic entered Doom's castle and lowered the drawbridge to allow Zorba and his men to enter. thumb|right|Zorba with Mr Fantastic The freedom fighters assaulted the castle. Once inside, Zorba's men were surprised by a gas-based trap. Zorba asked Mr. Fantastic to leave them and continue the mission but, when Mr. Fantastic took only Zorba with him, Zorba was angry at having left his men behind. Mr. Fantastic explained him that Doom was not likely to murder the intruders at once. Their conversation was interrupted by the arrival of Doom's scientist Gert Hauptmann — brother to Gustav — and took an adviser named Starn. The Fantastic Four gave their support to Zorba's rule, attending his crowning ceremony. However, the military leaders who had thrived under Doom refused to obey Zorba and instead they went missing, joining an underground movement of Doom loyalists that also included an undercover agent in the Castle: Hauptmann. This was the first problem of Zorba: Doom's military strength gave Latveria an stability that Zorba was not matching. Zorba also failed to earn money as fast as Doom could. Zorba was forced to increase prices and taxes, Soon afterward, inflation skyrocketed, and stocks of food ran out. started his gambit to recover the throne from exile. Doom gained control over the Latverian Embassy in New York City in his scheme to recover the throne. He captured the Fantastic Four, then submitted them to an Inhibitor Ray so that they could not attack Doom, then took them to Latveria in a Saucer Ship, where he explained to them the disasters of Zorba's rule. The Fantastic Four joined Doom to fight the robots, then the five of them joined the resistance against Zorba's government - led by Josef, Burgermeister of Doomstadt, Having been released from Zorba's police state horrors, the Latverian people again revered Doom.
abilities: A charismatic leader, Zorba was able to persuade the masses to rebel and was also a successful weapon smuggler.
weaknesses: Zorba had limited knowledge of mathematics and of the psychology of the masses. As his right eye has been removed, he is blind on that side.

zorbra.name: Zorbra
zorbra.origin: An obscure superhero who joined Professor Echs's Obscurity Legion, trying to make her country (probably Israel) proud. Professor Echs happened to be writer Scott Lobdell, and his idea for a series on Obscurity Legion was disliked by editor Tom DeFalco. The Obscurity Legion eventually dissolved because it all had been a hoax, an imaginary story and a dream sequence, orchestrated by the What-iffer.

zorka.name: Zorka
zorka.origin: Zorka was one of Conan's , who fled from the Kothians of King Strabonus through the Lake of Salts. When they set up camp in Dagoth Hill, he fought first against the pursuing Kothians and then against the awakened Devourer of Souls. The Free Companions were then offered to provide fresh souls for the Devourer, but he was confronted by Conan and Isparana and eventually consumed by Acheron, his human aspect. In Zamora, Zorka set up camp in an oasis not far from Shadizar, where the Cimmerian was kidnapped by the assassins of the Night Cult and brought back to Shadizar. Believing the barbarian was bad luck, the Free Companions voted to name Milo as their new captain. When Conan returned, Zorka slain in cold blood Hundolph, an Ophirean who was trying to defend the Cimmerian. He later encountered Conan while roaming the Turanian steppes. After Milo was killed, he was eventually captured by the Cimmerian, but managed to escape and ride to Prince Yezdigerd's camp, where he told him about Conan's resistance army. With no respect for a traitor, the Turanian prince ordered Grimm to execute Zorka, who was immediately decapitated.

zoroba.name: Zoroba
zoroba.origin: Zoroba was a demon who lived in the netherworld of Hades. In 1950, during a period in which Hades was briefly ruled by Asgardian trickster god Loki, Zoroba was approached by the Olympian god Apollo who sought a means to go to Earth without Jupiter knowing. To this end, Apollo and Zoroba made a deal that Zoroba would return to Olympus possessing Apollo's body while Apollo's spirit went to Earth to try and win back the heart of Venus. Posing as Apollo, Zoroba then summoned Loki and brought him to Olympus. Then he confronted Jupiter and attempted to convince him to let Loki stay on Olympus or face an invasion from the forces of Hades. Jupiter needed time to discuss it with his council but correctly deduced that "Apollo" was nothing more than an impostor. He then contacted Venus who was at he time trying to deal with Apollo, who had possessed the body of her co-worker Marvin Klee at Beauty Magazine. Realizing what was going on, and knowing that Apollo was trapped on Earth so long as Zoroba possessed his body, Venus return to Olympus. There she used her love powers to seduce Zoroba and trick him into returning with her to Earth, freeing Apollo's form. Venus then convinced a police officer that Zoroba was a Communist spy and had him arrested. Zoroba found himself in a mortal jail until Apollo arrived to return him to Hades. His subsequent fate is unknown.
powers: The full extent of Zoroba's demonic powers is unknown. He has shown the ability to possess the body of a god, but this appears to only work if the host is willing to relinquish their body over to him.

zorr luphomoid.name: Zorr (Luphomoid)
zorr luphomoid.origin: Zorr is a Luphomoid, a powerful race of ostensibly warriors/conquerors. It's unclear whether his degree of power is typical or whether he is a mutant or mutate of his species. Kraa, his younger brother, possesses comparable, if not stronger, abilities. Zorr's starship appeared in the Tranta System, shrugging off Xandar's Nova Corps and destroying the majority of their fleet, before syphoning energy from the planet Xandar to use against Galactus. The Nova Prime spacecraft, piloted by Centurion Nova-Prime Rhomann Dey, assaulted Zorr's ship as a last-ditch effort. Dey managed to drive off Zorr before he could syphon all the energy he required, while being unable to save Xandar, whose internal strains tore it apart. Dey pursued Zorr from one star system to the next, stopping him from carrying out his intentions on a constant basis. Zorr finally slew the last of the resistance, Centurion Nova-Prime Rhomann Dey, but he was either unable to extract the energy he need from Xandar, or the energy he did obtain was insufficient. Zorr went on a rampage in New York City, where he bumped across Richard Rider, whom Dey had given his power, outfit, title, and responsibilities to. Richard, despite his inexperience, was able to distract Zorr long enough for Dey to utilize his Nova-Prime Starship to lock on to him, transport him aboard, and disintegrate him by channeling the ship's full strength into him. In the process of doing so, Dey expended the last of his vitality and died, leaving only the empty Zorr outfit on the floor of his ship.

zorr robot.name: Zorr (Robot)
zorr robot.origin: Zorr was a robot created by the Inhuman known as Maximus the Mad during one of his early takeovers of the Inhuman throne. With the Inhuman royal family defeated and captured, Zorr was the last line of defense from other invaders. Zorr was used to fend off an attack by the Fantastic Four. The robot appeared to be indestructible and easily defeated its targets. Deducing that Zorr was able to defeat them thanks to a hypnotic device that sapped their will to fight, Mister Fantastic disorientated the robot long enough for the Thing to shake off the effects of this hypnosis and hit Zorr as hard as he could, destroying the robot. Maximus was defeated shortly thereafter and his brother Black Bolt regained the Inhuman throne.
weapons: In the place of its left hand, Zorr had a blaster.

His and Meranno's plans were foiled by the combined power of the Black Panther and the Atlantean king Namor, who had joined forces with T'Challa while investigating Meranno's involvement with General Zoruun through a different angle. After Namor restrained General Zoruun, Black Panther had him keep quiet about what had just transpired unless he wanted to risk the peace between Wakanda and Niganda.

zsombor vryslaw.name: Zsombor Vryslaw
zsombor vryslaw.origin: During the 1800's, Count Zsombor Vryslaw witnessed how Dracula turned his wife, Countess Nikolett Vryslaw into a vampire. Vryslaw locked her up for 20 years and went out to kill young girls to bring her a fresh supply of blood. Eventually, the townsfolk suspected that Dracula was the attacker, and defended themselves against vampires. Upon his arrival to the village, Dracula was surprised about the defenses, and correctly guessed that Count Vryslaw was responsible. Despite being prepared, Vryslaw could not defeat Dracula due to his age, and instead lured him to the chamber where his wife was locked up. Vryslaw made an attempt to kill Dracula with an arrow, but Dracula transformed himself into mist to avoid it. Vryslaw then marked a cross with the blood to keep Dracula at bay, and then proceeded to kill his wife before succumbing to a heart attack and denying Dracula his revenge.

Like the rest of Uovu's followers, Zuberi prosecuted and killed people that refused to denounce Ororo, and they amassed a death toll that almost reached a hundred of victims in the years ever since Uovu appeared. When Ororo returned to Uzuri after news of the death of her adoptive mother Ainet Mwangi reached her, Zuberi suggested eliminating her. Uovu first attempted to sway her to his side. During Storm's final confrontation against Uovu, Zuberi tried to flee from the village. He was stopped by one of Ororo's teammates from the X-Men, Prestige.

zuckel.name: Zuckel
zuckel.origin: Zuckel was the assistant of Dr. Victor Frankenstein who helped him bring his monster to life. The monster woke up and chased both men. Victor gave Zuckel a revolver to kill the monster and fled. The monster caught Zuckel blinding him in one eye and the creature fell off a cliff seemingly dying. Later, Zuckel reappeared before Victor with an eye patch and began to blackmail him into giving him money or telling everyone what happened. Victor gave him a large sum of money, but Zuckel wanted more and started scaring Victor and his wife, Elizabeth Lavenza into believing that the monster was stalking them. Victor found out what Zuckel was doing and confronted him, but Zuckel convinced him to give him even more money and told him that they would meet the next night near a river. The next day, Zuckel appeared before Victor's daughter, Emily Frankenstein and convinced her that her father was keeping a secret and to give him a message. Emily spoke to her father and Victor was enraged and vowed to kill Zuckel. Victor took a revolver and left to meet Zuckel. At the place where they had to meet Zuckel was attacked by the monster and Victor saw that the monster broke his neck and threw him into the water. The next day, someone pulled Zuckel's body out of the river and detective Belbeau together with his men examined Zuckel's corpse.

zugthuu.name: Zugthuu
zugthuu.species: God cast into demonic form by a higher being, worm-demon
zugthuu.origin: ===Origins=== Zugthuu the Slitherer was a god during the Pre-Cataclysmic Age. Presumably for some nameless crime beyond imagination, he was cast by a higher being, possibly Valka, into the demonic form of a worm-demon. ===Age of Kull (18,500 BC)=== That giant slug-like creature was held in the undergrounds of the Palace of Kamula, Valusia, where the decadent court of Kamula (including Baron Ergon of the Northern Shore, the dancing girl Zareta, and Taligaro the poet, and all the nobles and lords that Kull had met in Kamula, presumably including Prince Mandara) held twisted rites as part of their unholy worship of Zugthuu. On a visit of King Kull accompanied by Brule and a few Pict, one of them, Grogar, was abducted for such ceremony. Kull interrupted the rite, slaughtering his hosts, then attacked the sluggish creature. While slashing it in vain, Kull recognized in its eyes a pain originated from the sadness of an intelligent mind locked in a primeval form. He stopped and instead set the monster aflame, as an act of inspiration or compassion. Before fleeing with Grogar, Kull saw gratitude in the eyes of the creature.

Howard (Lin Carter named that character). The story was adapted in "The Beast from the Abyss" ( ; October, 1974) by Steve Englehart and Howard Chaykin. zuhn.name: Zuhn
zuhn.origin: ===Origin=== Zuhn was a Skrull Commander working as a scout for the 21st Observation Corps who, like the vast majority of members of his race, possessed the ability to shapeshift. He worked as scout for the Skrull Empire along with his lieutenant Velmax they was charged with spying on Earth for a potential invasion. ===Roswell UFO Incident=== In 1947, his ship was flying over the American Southwest and the ship was spotted and fired upon by the US Air Force causing them to crash-land. They was found by an Earthman named Jacob Scott and he attacked out of fear. Zuhn had sustained serious injury, and Velmax sealed him in a regenerative cocoon in hopes that Zuhn might revive. However Velmax, was too late to prevent the Skrull ship to be appropriated by the United States government. He used his shape-changing abilities to take the form of Jacob Scott to avoid capture and eventually became involved in the U.S. military. ===Escape=== Eventually, Zuhn revived, escaping from his cocoon and his human captors by staging a fire that covered his trail. Zuhn sought to track down the stolen Skrull technology, which had by then become scattered to various facilities. He created (or appropriated) various identities in order to search for such technology. At one point he posed as a Russian criminal scientist, and with supervillain lackeys, tried to steal Skrull equipment from a U.S. facility, only to be opposed by Velmax and several costumed heroes (Zuhn was unaware of Velmax's true nature, and was inadvertently responsible in allowing him to develop the heroic identity of Effigy). ===Chimera=== Another identity of Zuhn was that of Mr. Winget, head of the Winget industrial company. He also created an alter ego for Winget, that of the shape-changing villain Chimera. As Chimera, Zuhn would used his powers to gain an advantage over his competitors. Later, Zuhn formed a partnership with the villainous Howler, to steal technology from his competitor Stark Industries. Instead, he was opposed by Effigy and his teammates, the First Line. In final battle with Effigy, Zuhn was killed, and in his dying moments the Skrulls learned the truth about each other's identities.

zula.name: Zula
zula.origin: ===Origins=== Zula was of royal blood, as the son of the the chieftain of the Zamballah, a tribal nation south of Darfar. Upon the time Zula was about to undergo his people's rites of manhood, Kushites allies rendered greedy by the price the Stygians paid for slaves attacked the Zamballah, killing his Zula's father and all the men, as they wanted only the female, more docile slaves. First driven by the impulse to enter the brawl, Zula reasoned himself, and didn't attack even as he saw the backside of his father's murderer. He decided to put the chief's son's ornaments on a slain warrior, and was captured as the last male of his race. ===Slave in Stygia=== The Kushite war-chief took a fancy to Zula, and kept him as body-slave instead of selling him right away. He was eventually sold to a Stygian who brought him to Kheshatta. ===Conan, Bêlit and the Black Corsairs=== ... After some time, long before three after leaving the Tigress crew, Zula and the former Black Corsairs eventually went different ways. Varnae, the first vampire, controlled the bat-like humanoids the Afterlings in an altercation with Conan, Red Sonja, and the sorcerer Zula. Zula used the Darkhold against Varnae casting an incomplete incantation that shocked him. Zula apologized to the others, explaining the spell as written was incomplete: "I'm sorry the incantation ended where it did-and only hurt Lord Varnae, rather than destroying him." He decided to put the chief's son's ornaments on a slain warrior, and was captured as the last male of his race. ===Slave in Stygia=== The Kushite war-chief took a fancy to Zula, and kept him as body-slave instead of selling him right away.
