zuzha yu.name: Zuzha Yu
zuzha yu.species: Human whose powers manifested in utero
zuzha yu.origin: ===Origin and Early Years=== Zuzha Yu is the daughter of an unnamed woman and Eugene Judd, the diminutive Canadian soldier-of-fortune turned super hero known as "Puck." In her early stages of life, Zuzha demonstrated superhuman abilities, first speaking while still in her mother's womb. For unrevealed reasons, Judd was forced to abandon Zuzha while she was still a baby. Never learning the identity of her father, whom she never forgave for leaving her, Zuzha was raised in Canada and attended McGill University in downtown Montreal, Quebec. Eventually expelled from college, Zuzha was forced to fend for herself and ultimately opened a tavern in the shadow of McGill University. Doubling as both bartender and bouncer, Zuzha would often use her skills to break up bar fights between college students and her local patrons. left|thumb|Zuzha as the new Puck ===Alpha Flight=== It was after one of these barroom brawls that Zuzha was approached by Dr. Walter Langkowski, the Canadian hero known as Sasquatch, who offered her membership in a new incarnation of Alpha Flight. Although Zuzha initially refused the offer, she was compelled to join the fledgling team after losing a bet to Langkowski. In exchange for her cooperation, Langkowski promised to tell Zuzha his theories as to how she received her superhuman powers. Code-named "Puck" and outfitted with a uniform constructed out of Unstable molecules, Zuzha was assembled alongside Sasquatch and four other Canadian heroes: Centennial, Major Mapleleaf, Yukon Jack, and the enigmatic anarchist known as Nemesis. 250px|left|thumb|Zuzha using her powers against some Box armors The mission of the new team was to rescue the original members of Alpha Flight, who had been captured by the Plodex, a race of aliens intent on conquering the universe. When the original members of Alpha Flight were finally freed from the subterranean Plodex hatchery, they decided to temporarily relocate to the restored Plodex homeworld in an attempt to raise the next generation of Plodex. Zuzha and her fellow recruits agreed to remain together as a team and keep Canada safe in the original Alpha Flight's absence. In the time spent as a member of Alpha Flight, she developed romantic feelings for her teammate Major Mapleleaf. Lois and Zuzha eventually marry and have a son. ===Death=== She was among those killed by Michael Pointer, known as the Collective, while he was controlled by the mutant energies released on M-Day, namely Xorn.
abilities: Skilled Fighter: She is a skilled hand-to-hand combatant, combining various with techniques. Acrobatics: Zuzha is an Olympic-level and .

zvilpogghua.name: Zvilpogghua
zvilpogghua.origin: ===Origin and Early Years=== Zvilpogghua, the Feaster From the Stars, was one of the Great Old Ones of Lovecraft. It was cast into "The Abyss", the N-Zone, by the ancestors of Atlantis and their Old Gods, and remained there sleeping for millions of years. ===Modern Age=== He manifested himself when the Fantastic Four traveled into the N-Zone. Johnny Storm, considered the most powerful host, was infected with Zvilpogghua, who initially appeared as a parasite growing in his stomach. After failing to remove the parasite, Reed Richards was forced to turn to Doctor Doom for assistance. Using ancient magical texts recovered from Atlantis, Doom was able to remove Zvilpogghua from Johnny's body (although he intended to have it banished and not trapped in the physical world). Zvilpogghua then possessed Doom (while Reed Richards inhabited his body), and was carried into the Zombie Universe by Doom (who rejoined his mind and body), where he sacrificed himself.

zxaxz.name: Zxaxz
zxaxz.origin: Zxaxz was a 'spellbinder', a powerful magic user who could harness the power of order and chaos to reshape reality. Once a hero in his own dimension, he forged a pair of magical rings to enhance his power in order to drive off his rival spellbinder, the 'Other'. However, the power he wielded eventually drove him mad. He became a brutal conqueror, crushing any rebellion and destroying entire worlds, believing everything he did was necessary to hold back the Other. After learning of the existence of a third spellbinder, the human Erica Fortune, Zxaxz travelled to Earth to destroy this potential threat to his rule. Erica managed to take his rings and used their power to destroy him. However, the increasingly erratic Erica soon restored him as well. Zxaxz attacked Erica's friends and family in an attempt to drive her out, but when they confronted each other again, the energy released by their struggle attracted the attention of the Other. Zxaxz agreed to a brief truce with Erica in order to work together against his true enemy. Zxaxz drove the Other back to his home dimension. Zxaxz's empire was briefly usurped by the now power-mad Erica Fortune, but he was eventually able to overthrow her. After imprisoning her within a crystal structure, he attempted to ransom her back to her family in exchange for the return of his rings, which were in the possession of Erica's brother Roy. Roy defeated him and left him trapped within a black hole.
abilities: Zxaxz was a powerful magic user, with the ability to fly, shape-shift, transform into a gigantic form, and open portals to alternate dimensions.
weaknesses: Zxaxz was extremely sensitive to , such as that from a camera flash.

fields.unusual_features: Three fingers on each hand, two toes on each foot, horns on side of face, pointed chin, long lizard-like tail

eriu.name: Ériu
eriu.origin: ===Origins=== Ériu was a goddess of the Tuatha de Danaan and the sister of Nuada, the ruler of the Tuatha. As Nuada's sister, she was also believed to be the sibling of the Dagda, Leir, Badb, Macha, Morrigan, and Ogma. This connection also suggests that she was the daughter of Iarbonel and Danu. ====Progeny==== Around 1896 BC, the Tuatha de Danaan migrated from the Otherworld to Earth, where they encountered the Fomorians, a rival group with whom they had a long-standing conflict. Despite the animosity between the two factions, Ériu secretly coupled with Elathan, a Fomorian prince. From this union, she bore a son named Bres, but concealed Bres' Fomorian heritage. ===Tuatha on Earth=== When Ériu's brother, Nuada, suffered a severe injury, he was compelled to abdicate. Bres, who had matured unusually quickly, was chosen as his successor. However, his seven-year reign was marked by tyranny, leading to his eventual overthrow by the Tuatha. Upon his deposition, Ériu revealed Bres' true parentage, prompting him to leave the Tuatha and join his father, Elathan, among the Fomorians. ===12th Century=== In the 12th century, the Fomorians launched an assault on Avalon, the sacred land of the Tuatha. During the ensuing battle, Amergin Glúingel, the High Druid of Avalon, confronted Bres, reminding him of his human mother and urging him not to bring harm to her people. Bres rejected this plea, declaring that he identified solely with his Fomorian father and his lineage.

Bres, who had matured unusually quickly, was chosen as his successor. However, his seven-year reign was marked by tyranny, leading to his eventual overthrow by the Tuatha. Upon his deposition, Ériu revealed Bres' true parentage, prompting him to leave the Tuatha and join his father, Elathan, among the Fomorians. ===12th Century=== In the 12th century, the Fomorians launched an assault on Avalon, the sacred land of the Tuatha. During the ensuing battle, Amergin Glúingel, the High Druid of Avalon, confronted Bres, reminding him of his human mother and urging him not to bring harm to her people. Bres rejected this plea, declaring that he identified solely with his Fomorian father and his lineage.
fields.notes: Nuada's and the Tuatha de Danaan's entries in states that Bres was the nephew of Nuada, meaning that Ériu was seemingly sister to Nuada. As Nuada's sister, she was also believed to be the sibling of the Dagda, Leir, Badb, Macha, Morrigan, and Ogma.

ogedei khan.name: Ögedei Khan
ogedei khan.origin: Ögedei Khan was the third son of Genghis Khan and second khagan-emperor of the Mongol Empire, succeeding his father. In 1242 AD he sent General Subutai to invade Europe with the Mongol horde. The Eternal; Kingo Sunen learned that Druig was marching with them and believed he was controlling their minds. He confronted him at a campfire and the warrior fired arrows at him but Kingo just plucked them out of the air. Druig revealed the truth that he was not controlling the Mongols, and he has had nothing to do with the rise of the Mongol Empire nor their brutally efficient methods he was just there to study them. Druig suggested that if he wanted to stop them he should assassinate Subutai. Kingo crept into the leader's tent but could not bring himself to do it, fearing he would become like Druig. The next day; Subutai and his Horde returned home and Druig has stayed to meet with Kingo. He explained that Ogedei Khan had died of a stroke and the Mongols must return home to select a new ruler. Druig claimed not to have known what was happened but stated that if he killed Subutai the Horde would have continued into Europe killing thousands more.

de.name: Øde
de.origin: King Øde had been a mortal king in an age before the gods, until he attempted to harness the power of the eldritch font of darkness and antilife known to the Asgardians as the Røkkva. For a time, Øde succeeded in doing so and became the most powerful being in the Ten Realms. Corrupted and consumed from the inside-out by it, Øde was twisted to evil and ultimately left a blackened soulless husk that was neither alive nor truly dead. At some point, Øde was slain by a weapon fashioned from the white wood of Fiererheim, the only material capable of purging the Røkkva. After his death, his body was buried in a shallow grave in the Barren Mountains of Jotunheim, near the vault where the Røkkva was sealed, and the All-Fathers of Asgard were tasked with keeping watch lest the Røkkva escape and make a resurgence. At some point following the War of the Realms, Tyr Odinson stole Øde's body and brought it to a cavern deep below Manhattan, attempting to resurrect him with the sap of Yggdrasill. As the Røkkva had destroyed Øde's soul, the ritual failed and caused the Røkkva inside Øde to metastasize into a horde of monsters that burrowed to the surface all over the world. Upon discovering Øde's body alongside Valkyrie, All-Father Thor attempted to destroy it with Mjolnir but was infected by the Røkkva. Using Undrjarn the All-Weapon to manifest a spear formed from the white wood of Fiererheim, Valkyrie was able to destroy Øde's corpse, causing most of the Røkkva metastasizing from it to dissipate.
weapons: Øde's grave contained the shattered remains of several swords and axes, likely buried with him as grave goods.
